chat:en:what documents do i need to get:
Documents for Get the home-based vocational licence:
- Commercial register certificate
- Lease contract, owner's written consent, or title deed
- Undertaking to allow municipal inspection
- Undertaking not to disturb neighbours and to follow the licence conditions
- JFDA approval for home food production (only for food businesses)
chat:en:can i run a bakery from home: Yes. Food activities allowed from home include home-baked goods (cakes, pastries, biscuits, sweets), jams, pickles, jameed, prepared vegetables, and herbs and legumes, all made by hand. You first need JFDA approval (Jordan Food and Drug Administration), then the home-based vocational licence from GAM (20-50 JOD, about 3 working days). Food businesses in Amman can't receive customers at home.
chat:ar:كم رسوم رخصه المهن للمشروع المنز: الحصول على رخصة المهن المنزلية: 20 إلى 50 ديناراً رسم أساسي حسب نوع المهنة. تُدفع لدى أمانة عمّان الكبرى (رخص المهن).
chat:ar:هل لازم اسجل بالضمان اذا ما عندي: نعم. الاشتراك في الضمان الاجتماعي إلزامي لمالك المؤسسة الفردية الذي يعمل فيها حتى لو كان يعمل وحده، ولكل عامل عندما يكون لديك عامل واحد أو أكثر. تُدفع الاشتراكات شهرياً خلال 15 يوماً من الشهر التالي.
chat:en:what is the minimum capital for: The minimum capital for an LLC is 1 JOD. A sole proprietorship declares at least 1,000 JOD, with no deposit required. General and limited partnerships need at least 1,000 JOD.
chat:en:what is the income tax rate for: I don't have verified information about income tax rates; they depend on your business type and income. Please ask the Income and Sales Tax Department (ISTD).
